findings.title: Health flips to draining but shutdown starts immediately, leaving no drain window for load balancers
findings.evidence: The signal handler sets the draining flag and then calls Shutdown right away, so the server stops accepting new connections immediately instead of remaining up long enough for external health checks to observe the unhealthy state and stop routing traffic.
findings.recommendation: Insert an explicit pre-shutdown drain delay after setting 'draining' and before calling 'srv.Shutdown', or otherwise coordinate with the load balancer's health-check interval so the unhealthy state can be observed before listeners are closed.
